title: Dodo (Fried Plantain)
description: Sweet ripe plantain fried until caramelised and golden at the edges. The side that goes with everything.

image.alt: Plate of golden fried plantain slices arranged in a circle

ingredients.note: Yellow with plenty of black spots
ingredients.constraint: Must be ripe — green plantain won't caramelise

ingredients.note: About 2 cm deep in the pan

steps.instruction: Cut off both ends of each plantain, slit the skin lengthwise and peel. Slice diagonally about 1 cm thick and toss with a little salt.
Heat the oil in the pan. Test with one slice.

cues.sound: The test slice sizzles steadily straight away.

steps.safetyNote: Never leave hot oil unattended. Keep a lid nearby.

steps.instruction: Lay the slices in the oil in a single layer and fry until golden underneath.

cues.visual: Deep golden with darker caramelised edges.

image.alt: Plantain slices bubbling in hot oil in a pan

steps.instruction: Turn each slice and fry the other side.
steps.completionNote: Both sides golden brown and soft inside.

steps.instruction: Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper. Repeat with the rest.

notes: The riper the plantain, the sweeter the dodo — and the faster it browns, so watch the heat.
Serve with jollof rice, beans porridge, eggs or stew.
